fields.Name: T353 - Add Archive Configuration Draft
fields.Description: Exercises the AddConfiguration() in-memory draft-creation path (client-side new record with seeded defaults, no DB round-trip) — fully data-agnostic, works even with an empty config list.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and select 'Archiving'. On the 'Configuration' tab, click the '+ Add Configuration' button in the header of the left-hand configuration list. Success is seeing a new draft configuration named 'New Configuration' appear at the top of the list AND the right detail panel render with editable form fields pre-filled with defaults (e.g. Retention Days, Batch Size, an Archive Mode dropdown). Do NOT click Save — verifying the draft form renders is enough. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Add Configuration' adds a new 'New Configuration' entry to the config list and selects it
The detail panel renders editable fields including Name, Retention Days / Batch Size, and an Archive Mode selector populated with default values
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
